semantics: Transcripts are source data; explicit Retain uses the shared DOM readback commit. Playback speaks retained replies or authored guide steps only. General guide reply generation remains unbound.
scope: Linux Electron rendered the exact final shared assets for both isolated origins.
Windows path used the real native HTTPS route/manager, with injected System.Speech process callbacks; unsupported Linux availability was also observed.
Android path replayed Java-produced serializer fixture details, remapping only test correlation and selected source fields. This was not an Android device/runtime test.
Android unrelated capability/mapping routes were explicitly unavailable in the isolated voice harness.
The shared no-child End regression found in QA3 is fixed and all final QA5 flows pass.
No raw machine discovery metadata is included in this compact summary.
